handback.summary: Mapped release calls in the permission manifest and installed the settings reader before the release step.

criteria.755.1: `dokima/release.py` `run()` makes the v0.1.0 tag at the pushed commit; skips with no changelog, no section, or an existing release.
criteria.755.2: `run()` calls `gh release create`; refusal exits 1 with the reason. `dokima/manifest.py` maps release view and create to contents.
criteria.755.3: `section()` takes only the lines under the v0.1.0 heading as the notes, up to the next heading.

handback.evidence: `pytest -q` on release, settings setup, manifest tests: 80 passed

answers.why: The release workflow now installs the settings reader before running Dokima, as other workflows do.
